risk_note: RV2 ledger (B2-02zf; orchestrator D10-2982 item 2, D10-2987, D10-2988, D10-2997; the owner's decision of 2026-11-25 is approvals entry 186). One new exported function, registerReconDiffWriteOnly, in apps/api/src/modules/ledger/application/recon-diffs.ts: it runs the existing checkInput and the existing insertReconDiffIfAbsent (INSERT … ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING *) with the same row as registerReconDiffOnce and returns only whether this call inserted the row. On a conflict under any unique key it returns inserted=false at once: no findExisting, no SELECT / UPDATE / DELETE on recon_diffs, nothing sent through a compiled query or raw SQL; it runs on the caller's transaction only. Difference from registerReconDiffOnce: under the unresolved unique key (B2-02zc) a conflicting unresolved ticket that a concurrent transaction concludes after the INSERT makes the old port throw on its read-back, while the write-only port returns false. registerReconDiff, registerReconDiffOnce, findExisting, checkInput and infra/recon-diffs-store.ts are unchanged; none of the 12 existing call sites is switched; the monthly bill job and the admin supplement are wired to the new port by B2-18, so on main the port has no caller yet. No amount is computed or changed; no migration; no contract change; no existing rule test or kit is modified; no protected path is touched. Out-of-scope S2 notes of the two spec-test rounds and where they went (D10-2997): (1) the statement probe of the rule tests sits on Kysely's transformQuery and does not see compiled queries — carried by the implementation (no compiled query or raw SQL in the function) and by the implementer's unit tests [AC-B2-02zf#UNIT-2], [#UNIT-5], [#UNIT-6]; (2) the behaviour of the bill job and the supplement after the switch belongs to B2-18's rule tests; (3) case #16 cannot tell SQL NULL from jsonb null for resolution — the implementation hands the input to the existing insert function unchanged. Test machine on head 3455cdd60d55 (tree 58ac215ecc1f, main 8fd321556): verify-sharded-summary green with scope fast+test:int+test:browser (verify:fast parts base / spec-1 / spec-2 all exit 0; test:int segments 1-6 and rest all exit 0, 2232 files / 20067 tests = int_files_total; --browser exit 0), not_covered test:smoke and db:check (not run on the test machine; this task has no migration). Before that, on the reviewed tree 913d6846853d: six ledger-related rule-test directories 34 files / 185 tests green and verify:fast exit 0. The required CI checks are the full verification.
